newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INJURED ALBERTINI OUT OF POLAND-ITALY MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURED ALBERTINI OUT OF POLAND-ITALY MATCH.

text.p: AC Milan midfielder Demetrio Albertini has been dropped from Italy's starting line-up for Wednesday's World Cup qualifier against Poland in Chorzow because of injury, Italian television reported.
It said Albertini, who had complained of pain in a testicle, would be replaced by Diego Fuser of Lazio.
Italy, who beat Moldova 3-0 on Saturday, lead European group two with an unbeaten record but have played two games more than Poland, who lie third behind England.
